name: Chart Recorder
description: Plots the voltage of two channels over the whole run on the schematic; reference data from a CSV of bench measurements can be drawn over it

parameters.name: width
parameters.label: Width
parameters.description: Width of the plot in grid units (also set by dragging its corner)

parameters.name: height
parameters.label: Height
parameters.description: Height of the plot in grid units (also set by dragging its corner)

parameters.name: time_mode
parameters.label: Time axis
parameters.description: fixed: from the start of the run to the time window; rolling: the last time window

parameters.name: vertical
parameters.label: Vertical scale
parameters.description: auto: fits the traces and references shown; manual: from Minimum to Maximum

parameters.name: v_min
parameters.label: Minimum
parameters.description: Bottom of the vertical axis (manual scale)

parameters.name: v_max
parameters.label: Maximum
parameters.description: Top of the vertical axis (manual scale)

parameters.name: ch1_reference
parameters.label: CH1 reference
parameters.description: Reference data of channel 1: "time value" pairs in seconds and volts, separated by ';' (imported from a CSV)

parameters.name: ch2_reference
parameters.label: CH2 reference
parameters.description: Reference data of channel 2: "time value" pairs in seconds and volts, separated by ';' (imported from a CSV)
